name: Chapel View
summary: Chapel View is an award-winning mixed-use lifestyle center in Cranston, Rhode Island, featuring a unique village atmosphere with upscale retail, dining, office space, and luxury condominiums. Developed by Carpionato Group and featured in major publications including The New York Times, this live-work-play destination continues to expand with new food concepts and premium offerings.
demographics: Chapel View attracts an affluent, educated demographic from Cranston and surrounding Rhode Island communities, with primary visitors being middle to upper-middle income households earning $75,000-$150,000 annually. The trade area serves young professionals, families with children, and empty nesters aged 30-65 who value the mixed-use live-work-play environment and upscale retail offerings. Shoppers are drawn to the center's unique village atmosphere, high-end condominiums, and first-class office space, creating a sophisticated customer base that frequents both the retail shops and dining establishments throughout the day and evening hours.
description: Chapel View is an enchanting mixed-use village in Cranston, Rhode Island, developed by the prestigious Carpionato Group with its first phase debuting in 2008. This award-winning lifestyle destination has garnered significant media attention, being featured in The New York Times, The Providence Journal, and Rhode Island Monthly's Home & Design Magazine for its unique, historically-significant architecture and innovative live-work-play concept. The center seamlessly blends vibrant retail offerings with first-class office space and exclusive high-end condominiums, creating a sophisticated village atmosphere that sets it apart from traditional shopping centers. Recent expansions have brought exciting new food concepts to the property, including a newly opened CAVA location, further enhancing the diverse dining and shopping experience. With its carefully curated mix of tenants, Chapel View continues to evolve as a premier destination that serves both residents and visitors seeking an upscale, community-oriented shopping and lifestyle experience in the heart of Rhode Island.
